source: read from /opt/acb/app/.env on the production box
note: An org list that holds * becomes the eval org (ds.ORG) in the eval process. TOOL_SEARCH_ORGS names one org on the box, not the eval org, so it stays empty here.

why.TOOL_PACKS_ORGS: tool list: packs for this org
why.AI_TURN_KIND_PARALLEL: routing: turn-kind request runs in parallel
why.TOOL_SEARCH_ORGS: names one org on the box, not the eval org: left empty
why.AI_TIER_ROUTING: routing: the tier of each agent. The eval ran 'orchestrator'; production routes every agent
why.AI_REASONING_OFF_AGENTS: routing: the orchestrator runs with reasoning off
why.ASSISTANT_PROFILE_ENABLED: tool list: resolve_person and the profile write tools, and the profile block of the turn context
why.ASSISTANT_PROFILE_CARD_WRITES_ORGS: cards: the profile writes show a card
why.CHAT_DURABLE_ASKS: cards: a question or card of the chat is stored, so it survives the run
why.CHAT_FIRST_TOOLS: tool list: the chat-first tool set
why.CONTEXT_RECENCY: persona and context: the recency block of the turn context
why.CRM_ORGS: tool list: the CRM tools for this org
why.CRM_CATALOGUE_ORGS: tool list: the CRM catalogue tools
why.CRM_DECIDE_ORGS: tool list: the CRM decide tool
why.CRM_NOTE_SEARCH_ORGS: tool list: the CRM note search
why.CRM_PIPELINES_ORGS: tool list: the CRM pipeline tools
why.CRM_QUESTIONS_ORGS: rules and cards: the CRM questions
why.SYSTEM_ONE_ON_DECIDE: routing: decide answers go to System 1
why.KNOWLEDGE_ORGS: tool list: the knowledge tools for this org
why.MAF_MCP_ORGS: tool list: tools of MCP servers (the eval org has no server, so none appear)
why.TOOL_ARG_SHAPES: tool text: the argument shapes of the tool schemas
why.AGENT_ACCESS_ENABLED: tool list: the agent access tools
why.AGENT_ACCESS_ORGS: tool list: the agent access tools for this org
why.PROJECTS_TEMPLATES_ORGS: tool list: the Projects template tools
why.PROJECT_RULES_ORGS: tool list: the Projects rule tools
why.EMAIL_HELD_CARD_SEND: cards: the held send card (also in PRODUCTION)
why.DECIDE_ENABLED: tool list: the decide tool (decide_tools.py reads it) and the decide call of acb_llm

left_out.CRM_ANSWER_CHECK: left out: a shadow check after the answer. It changes no tool, rule or card
left_out.CRM_MIRROR: left out: it gates only the gateway routes of the Zoho connection. The Mirror mode of a chat is the Scenario.mode of the chat
left_out.CRM_MIRROR_ORGS: left out: the same, the org list of the Zoho connection routes
left_out.DECIDE_FEATURE_ORGS: left out: orgs that may run a per-feature decide mode (gateway/decide_features.py, email cold check). Outside a turn
left_out.DECIDE_FEATURE_MODES: left out: feature=mode pairs for the same gateway decide features (shadow or off). Outside a turn. The value was not read, and none is invented
